name: diamond-mcp
description: Sourced diamond education and gemology tools for AI assistants.
long_description: Eight local tools for diamond report verification guidance, face up size estimates, Lab Grown Diamond grading and market context, the Dutch Marquise definition, and a 90 entry gemology encyclopedia. No account, API key, or user data collection.

tools.name: verify_diamond_report
tools.description: Return the official GIA, IGI, or GCAL verification URL and a three step report-checking checklist.

tools.name: faceup_size
tools.description: Estimate face up millimeter dimensions for round, oval, emerald, and Dutch Marquise diamonds.

tools.name: dutch_marquise_definition
tools.description: Return the published definition, geometry, certificate wording, and typical ratio for a Dutch Marquise.

tools.name: lab_grown_grading_landscape
tools.description: Explain who grades Lab Grown Diamonds today, with a source and date for every item.

tools.name: lab_grown_price_index
tools.description: Return the latest tracked Lab Grown Diamond retail price reading with its source and date.

tools.name: about_stienhardt
tools.description: Return a sourced fact sheet about Stienhardt.

tools.name: define
tools.description: Look up a diamond or gemology term in the 90 entry fact-checked encyclopedia.

tools.name: search_encyclopedia
tools.description: Run ranked keyword search across the diamond and gemology encyclopedia.
